metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: CVE-2026-68820 — Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock  Exploitation
properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-68820: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.. Product: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "CVE-2026-68820" or Message contains "WINDOWS ANCILLARY FUNCTION DRIVER FOR WINSOCK" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 3
